entries.05aa782e322a5bb9: Wholesale of commercial food products and sales at direct-sales centers
entries.0d5edb748cb2f9b7: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,252 million. In the previous year, it was ¥1,315 million.
entries.0fa68bf9a220743c: Wholesale proceeds from commercial food products
entries.1326ce301ebb7472: It is a wholesale trading company for commercial food products with its management base in the Tohoku region. No specific customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue, and its customers are spread across a wide range of industries, including restaurants, catering, confectionery and retail. There is no revenue from external customers outside Japan.
entries.1a6635711056651d: This is a business model in which the company and its subsidiaries purchase commercial food products, centered on cooked frozen foods, and sell them wholesale to restaurant, catering and confectionery businesses, etc., while also selling them to individual business operators and general consumers through direct-sales centers.
entries.1a6e4b3c30ec017d: This reportable segment consists of the company's 21 direct-sales centers for business-use food, which sell various food products for business use, centered on cooked and frozen foods, in the Miyagi, Iwate, Yamagata, Fukushima and Akita prefectures.
entries.35738591f87dbc8e: Centered on cooked frozen foods, the company purchases and supplies commercial food products such as confectionery ingredients, marine products, agricultural products, livestock products and seasonings, and also sells them at 21 commercial food direct-sales center stores.
entries.4668b3040fa155ee: In wholesale, the company sells to and delivers to restaurant operators such as hotels and restaurants, catering operators such as school lunch providers, confectionery and bakery businesses, and retailers. In retail, it sells to individual business operators and general consumers.
entries.5083e06056626a45: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥50,813 million, up 3.4% from the previous year. The wholesale division was ¥44,469 million and the retail division was ¥6,344 million.
entries.697b7a4677cb5e62: This reportable segment consists of two companies, the company and Akita Satoh Shokai Co., Ltd., which sell various food products for business use, centered on cooked and frozen foods. They sell and deliver ingredients for confectionery and bread making, school lunch supplies, supplies for food service businesses such as hotels and restaurants, and prepared dishes for retail stores. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥44,469 million.
entries.6eb1c8047767b211: Catering operators, such as school and workplace catering businesses
entries.839b2e46cf3a6185: It is a wholesale trading company for food for business use, headquartered in Miyagino Ward, Sendai City. The company forms a group with four subsidiaries and one affiliate, and consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 numbered 700. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

entries.c2c58e011af9478d: As a slogan looking ahead to 2030, the company has adopted 'A Food-Centered Marketing Solution Company: Toward a Company Contributing to Regional Revitalization Through Rich Food Culture', and its management policy for fiscal 2025 is 'Strengthening Sales Capabilities for Further Deepening and Expansion'. The company says it will create new value through close collaboration with stakeholders centered on the Tohoku region, and will strengthen its ability to develop value-added products that solve customers' challenges, in order to advance deeper penetration and expansion of its markets.

entries.e19b65e545c9d41e: A food trading company based in the Tohoku region that wholesales food for commercial use and also operates retail through 21 direct sales centers.
entries.e67d92b82ee4623c: It has sales offices and 21 commercial food direct-sales center stores across five Tohoku prefectures (Miyagi, Iwate, Yamagata, Fukushima and Akita), and has expanded to 17 shop-in-shop locations in Tsuruha stores, building a sales and distribution network closely rooted in the local community. Its support structure, which develops products and proposes menus by industry to solve customers' on-site challenges, is also a distinctive feature.
